integrity: A self-contained analytic proof and executable independent finite-case exhaustive checker are supplied. Finite experiments are not treated as proof for arbitrary item count.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-agent, complete-allocation Boolean-set-function theorem. Random-profile frequencies assume mutually independent Bernoulli(1/2) truth-table entries; other valuation classes and distributions are not covered. Independent validation has not been performed. Publication priority in unindexed literature remains open.
title: Exact envy-freeness and efficiency obstruction for two arbitrary Boolean valuations
